commitSubject: feat(public): add attendee registration form and attendees state

startingState.finding: T5-shaped UI already existed from commit 8636b97 with a real Chromium contract suite (22 tests, all green). The plan checkbox was still unchecked, so this task verified the existing surface against the T5 contract rather than rebuilding it.

contractRequirements.requirement: attendee panel in public/index.html following provider-panel hidden toggle + outside-click pattern
submit attendees through the setAttendees WS action
store meeting_id returned in the attendees message + roster for the later review dropdown
contractRequirements.evidence: after-driver.txt [happy] stored dropdown source -> window.__attendeeState {meetingId:4242, attendees:[3]}

contractRequirements.requirement: send that exact ID in startCapture
prevent recording when no prepared meeting ID exists while showing the save error
contractRequirements.evidence: unsaved drafts surface '저장하지 않은 참석자가 있습니다 — 저장 후 시작하세요'; capture still proceeds because attendees must NOT be a hard gate
client sent {action:'attendees'} but server handlerMap had no such key; request was silently dropped. See defect #1.

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Reconnect restoration was a silent no-op
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: public/app.js ws.onopen sent {action:'attendees'} on every reconnect, but server.ts handlerMap had no 'attendees' entry. server.ts message() only dispatches when a handler exists, so the restore request was dropped with no error. Draft attendees/meeting_id were never restored after a real WS reconnect, violating the T5 lifecycle contract.
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: server.ts: added read-only handleAttendeesQuery returning {type:'attendees', meeting_id, attendees}; answers the requesting socket only (no broadcast). Returns meeting_id:null + [] when no meeting is prepared.
tests: tests/public-attendees.test.ts: 'the reconnect restore query names an action the real server dispatches' (cross-checks client wire actions against the real server handlerMap)
tests/attendees-action.test.ts: restore round-trip against the real WS server, both with no prepared meeting and with a persisted roster
tests/server-handler-map.test.ts: registered the new action in the registry contract

defectsFoundAndFixed.title: Stale meeting ID after reset made recording fail silently
defectsFoundAndFixed.detail: server handleReset ends the prepared meeting and sets currentMeetingId=null, but the client kept attendeeState.meetingId. The next record click sent the dead ID, and startCapture rejected it with 'does not match the current prepared meeting' — recording appeared to do nothing.
defectsFoundAndFixed.redProof: 02-red-stale-id.txt — waitForFunction timed out; client never cleared the ID
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: public/app.js: added clearPreparedMeeting(), called from btnResetEl.onclick. Drops meetingId/attendees, marks drafts unsaved so the user can re-save, leaves the roster text intact.
tests: tests/public-attendees.test.ts: 'a reset clears the prepared meeting_id so capture never resends a dead id'

designSystem.analysis: public/style.css defines a token layer in :root (--line/--line-faint/--line-strong, --radius-sm/md/lg, --shadow-panel, --space-1..6, --text-label/xs/sm/body/md, --err-line/--err-soft, --live-line). The review panel (newest UI, commit 82ed28d) consumes these tokens throughout and is the established convention.
designSystem.finding: The attendee panel predated the token layer and duplicated those exact values as hardcoded literals (rgba(255,255,255,0.09), 14px, 0 18px 56px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), rgba(239,68,68,0.35), 10.5px, ...).
designSystem.action: Migrated the attendee CSS block to the existing tokens. Only literals with an exact token equivalent were substituted; genuine one-offs (999px pill radius, 13px pill padding, rgba(...,0.12) shared with provider-config, 9px micro-label) were left alone. No new tokens were invented and no values changed.
designSystem.proof: Pixel-neutrality proven by computed-style fingerprint captured from real Chromium before and after the migration (transitions disabled and hover/aria-expanded state pinned for determinism): before-computed-style.json == after-computed-style.json, and before-driver.txt == after-driver.txt. Both diffs empty.
